text: On the IPO question: with only $10 you can't participate in a US IPO — most require a $2,000+ account minimum and allocations go to institutional clients first. For Reliance on Zerodha delivery, the round-trip cost is exactly the ₹38.15 we tabled (STT ₹20 + exchange ₹0.59 + SEBI ₹0.02 + stamp ₹1.50 + GST ₹0.11 + DP ₹15.93), so a ₹10,000 buy needs a 0.38% move just to break even. Spotlight HDFC Bank trades at 11.1× forward earnings with a 3.9% dividend yield — cheap for a 21% grower — but the -31% one-year return and 1.08 beta mean it moves with the Nifty, not against it.
